typical_steps: Explain that ads help keep the base plan price affordable and offset the cost of newer or current content
Mention the availability of the No Commercials plan or add-on as an alternative option
Ask the customer to clarify their device, show, season, episode, or whether they are using Live TV
Provide troubleshooting steps such as rebooting the device and modem/router, clearing cache, or updating ad preferences via a PC or Mac
info_agent_requests: Do you have Hulu with Live TV?
What was being advertised or what brand is being advertised?
when_they_escalate_to_dm: Agents escalate to a direct message or 1:1 support when troubleshooting steps do not resolve the issue, when investigating technical errors, or when collecting specific account and device details.
phrases: Ads help us keep the price affordable
never_promises: Promising that specific ads can be permanently blocked
Promising exact ad-load or variety improvements by a specific date
Promising that all shows are included in the No Commercials plan
